jobs.title: Senior Red Team Operator, AI/LLM
jobs.description_text: ROLE OVERVIEW Every operator knows the ending. You found the path, chained it to access the crown jewel, and wrote it up. Then the engagement closed, the environment changed the next week, and nobody walked that kill chain again until next year's test. Armadin is built to end that cycle. We're building an agentic attacker swarm. These are specialized AI agents running custom models that discover, exploit, and chain vulnerabilities across external, internal, identity, cloud, and application attack surfaces. They run continuously, at machine speed, against live production environments. Until recently, nobody could put a nation-state-caliber adversary inside every network around the clock. That's the hyperattack, and it's what we do. In one recent engagement, the swarm generated more than 17 million offensive actions in three days and validated 38 attack paths. That's the scale your tradecraft will run at. As a Senior Red Team Operator, your tradecraft is the training signal. You'll run hands-on operations, and then you'll encode how you think into the reasoning our agents use at scale: how you pick a foothold, abuse an application's logic, pivot through identity, separate what's actually exploitable from scanner noise, and map the blast radius once you're in. You'll pressure-test full kill chains end to end, find where the swarm is naive, and teach it to move like an expert, using AI throughout your own workflow to go faster and deeper. This is not a traditional "monitor the dashboard" defensive SOC job; this career is technical, offensive-focused, and challenging, with opportunities to work at the cutting edge of AI-driven red teaming alongside world-class red teamers. A typical shift could involve reviewing an AI attacker's safety disengagement during a complex web application test, bypassing a sophisticated CAPTCHA to unblock an automated attack path, or providing the missing contextual judgment an AI needs to exploit a deep vulnerability. As an Armadin Attack Operations Center Analyst, you’ll get hands-on experience acting as the "human-in-the-loop" for complex security problems on a daily basis.
